protocol.status: Post-pilot development integration; spacing5 is already observed, not new held-out evidence
protocol.time_policy: H and CX layer:3 block-z; X:virtual Pauli frame; all readout deferred to common end. TICKs from compiler; QEC rounds null.
protocol.fairness: Same order generator/physical footprint; fixed-pool one/two cap16 plus same ceiling48. Equal ceiling does not imply equal actual work. Author pinned search is an additional unmatched-cost reference.
protocol.rollout: Drain full ready X/readout and H closure after candidate before next CX rollout; track orientation. H duration counted in final schedule, not in the CX-progress score. Not a two-physical-layer lookahead.
protocol.physical_policy: Exact full-layer source signature and geometry; recompile complete ideal/noisy/DEM once per distinct output. Prior counts and complete validation reused only if exact hashes match.
protocol.timing: After physics and full tests:3 warmups,25 repeats, rotated method order; source scheduling only, no model fit/physical compiler/MC/MWPM. Shared host possible.
